title: A finite set has approximate tangent space {0} in dimension 0 at each of its points
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let F ⊆ ℝ^P be a finite set and let y ∈ F. Then HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt 0 F y ⊥ holds (Simon Ch. 3, 1.4 with n = 0). Explicitly: the zero subspace ⊥ = {0} has dimension 0, and for every compactly supported continuous f : ℝ^P → ℝ, ∫_{η_{y,ρ}(F)} f dH⁰ → ∫_{{0}} f dH⁰ = f(0) as ρ → 0 with ρ > 0. Here η_{y,ρ}(z) = ρ⁻¹(z − y) is SimonGMT blowUpMap y ρ and H⁰ = μHE[0].
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (F : Set (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P), F.Finite → y ∈ F → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt 0 F y ⊥
